mentions.name: AppStoreSearch
mentions.description: An early-stage App Store Optimization (ASO) tool for tracking the positioning of apps in the app stores, built because existing app store tools left the author's friends dissatisfied.
mentions.problem: Existing app store tools dissatisfied app publishers whose income depends heavily on store rankings; even dropping from #1 to #2 can be a huge hit to their income.
mentions.audience: App developers whose income depends on their apps' positioning in the app stores
